en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

zhSimplified.text: 「你吩咐以色列人说：你们到了迦南地，就是归你们为业的迦南四境之地，

zhTraditional.text: 「你吩咐以色列人說：你們到了迦南地，就是歸你們為業的迦南四境之地，

en.text: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.

zhSimplified.text: 南角要从寻的旷野，贴着以东的边界；南界要从盐海东头起，

zhTraditional.text: 南角要從尋的曠野，貼着以東的邊界；南界要從鹽海東頭起，

en.text: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

zhSimplified.text: 绕到亚克拉滨坡的南边，接连到寻，直通到加低斯·巴尼亚的南边，又通到哈萨·亚达，接连到押们，

zhTraditional.text: 繞到亞克拉濱坡的南邊，接連到尋，直通到加低斯‧巴尼亞的南邊，又通到哈薩‧亞達，接連到押們，

en.text: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

zhSimplified.text: 从押们转到埃及小河，直通到海为止。

zhTraditional.text: 從押們轉到埃及小河，直通到海為止。

en.text: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

zhSimplified.text: 「西边要以大海为界；这就是你们的西界。

zhTraditional.text: 「西邊要以大海為界；這就是你們的西界。

en.text: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

zhSimplified.text: 「北界要从大海起，划到何珥山，

zhTraditional.text: 「北界要從大海起，劃到何珥山，

en.text: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

zhSimplified.text: 从何珥山划到哈马口，通到西达达，

zhTraditional.text: 從何珥山劃到哈馬口，通到西達達，

en.text: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

zhSimplified.text: 又通到西斐 ，直到哈萨·以难。这要作你们的北界。

zhTraditional.text: 又通到西斐崙，直到哈薩‧以難。這要作你們的北界。

en.text: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

zhSimplified.text: 「你们要从哈萨·以难划到示番为东界。

zhTraditional.text: 「你們要從哈薩‧以難劃到示番為東界。

en.text: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

zhSimplified.text: 这界要从示番下到亚延东边的利比拉，又要达到基尼烈湖的东边。

zhTraditional.text: 這界要從示番下到亞延東邊的利比拉，又要達到基尼烈湖的東邊。

en.text: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

zhSimplified.text: 这界要下到约旦河，通到盐海为止。这四围的边界以内，要作你们的地。」

zhTraditional.text: 這界要下到約旦河，通到鹽海為止。這四圍的邊界以內，要作你們的地。」

en.text: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

zhSimplified.text: 摩西吩咐以色列人说：「这地就是耶和华吩咐拈阄给九个半支派承受为业的；

zhTraditional.text: 摩西吩咐以色列人說：「這地就是耶和華吩咐拈鬮給九個半支派承受為業的；

en.text: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 因为吕便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了产业，玛拿西半个支派也受了产业。

zhTraditional.text: 因為呂便支派和迦得支派按着宗族受了產業，瑪拿西半個支派也受了產業。

en.text: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

zhSimplified.text: 这两个半支派已经在耶利哥对面、约旦河东、向日出之地受了产业。」

zhTraditional.text: 這兩個半支派已經在耶利哥對面、約旦河東、向日出之地受了產業。」

en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

zhSimplified.text: 「要给你们分地为业之人的名字是祭司以利亚撒和嫩的儿子约书亚。

zhTraditional.text: 「要給你們分地為業之人的名字是祭司以利亞撒和嫩的兒子約書亞。

en.text: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

zhSimplified.text: 又要从每支派中选一个首领帮助他们。

zhTraditional.text: 又要從每支派中選一個首領幫助他們。

en.text: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人的名字：犹大支派有耶孚尼的儿子迦勒。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人的名字：猶大支派有耶孚尼的兒子迦勒。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

zhSimplified.text: 西缅支派有亚米忽的儿子示母利。

zhTraditional.text: 西緬支派有亞米忽的兒子示母利。

en.text: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

zhSimplified.text: 便雅悯支派有基斯伦的儿子以利达。

zhTraditional.text: 便雅憫支派有基斯倫的兒子以利達。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

zhSimplified.text: 但支派有一个首领，约利的儿子布基。

zhTraditional.text: 但支派有一個首領，約利的兒子布基。

en.text: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

zhSimplified.text: 约瑟的子孙玛拿西支派有一个首领，以弗的儿子汉聂。

zhTraditional.text: 約瑟的子孫瑪拿西支派有一個首領，以弗的兒子漢聶。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

zhSimplified.text: 以法莲支派有一个首领，拾弗但的儿子基母利。

zhTraditional.text: 以法蓮支派有一個首領，拾弗但的兒子基母利。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

zhSimplified.text: 西布伦支派有一个首领，帕纳的儿子以利撒番。

zhTraditional.text: 西布倫支派有一個首領，帕納的兒子以利撒番。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

zhSimplified.text: 以萨迦支派有一个首领，阿散的儿子帕铁。

zhTraditional.text: 以薩迦支派有一個首領，阿散的兒子帕鐵。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

zhSimplified.text: 亚设支派有一个首领，示罗米的儿子亚希忽。

zhTraditional.text: 亞設支派有一個首領，示羅米的兒子亞希忽。

en.text: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

zhSimplified.text: 拿弗他利支派有一个首领，亚米忽的儿子比大黑。」

zhTraditional.text: 拿弗他利支派有一個首領，亞米忽的兒子比大黑。」

en.text: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

zhSimplified.text: 这些人就是耶和华所吩咐、在迦南地把产业分给以色列人的。

zhTraditional.text: 這些人就是耶和華所吩咐、在迦南地把產業分給以色列人的。
